settings.fontSmoothingDescription.en: 회색조로 글꼴을 다듬습니다. 글자가 더 가늘게 보일 수 있으며 효과는 디스플레이에 따라 다릅니다.
settings.fontSmoothingDescription.zh: 开启后使用灰度平滑，文字可能显得更细。效果因显示器而异。

voiceInput.permission.description.mac.en: Click "Request again", then choose "Allow" in the system dialog. You can also turn on ZCode in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Microphone.
voiceInput.permission.description.mac.zh: 点击「重新授权」，然后在系统弹框中选择「允许」。也可以在「系统设置 › 隐私与安全性 › 麦克风」中打开 ZCode。

voiceInput.permission.restartDescription.en: The microphone permission was reset. Restart ZCode, click the microphone, then choose "Allow" in the system dialog.
voiceInput.permission.restartDescription.zh: 已重置麦克风授权。重启 ZCode 后点击麦克风，在系统弹框中选择「允许」。

voiceInput.permission.granted.en: Microphone access is on. Click the microphone to start voice input.
voiceInput.permission.granted.zh: 已开启麦克风权限，点击麦克风开始语音输入。

voiceInput.permission.description.window.en: In Settings › Privacy & security › Microphone, turn on both "Microphone access" and "Let desktop apps access your microphone".
voiceInput.permission.description.window.zh: 请在「设置 › 隐私和安全性 › 麦克风」中同时打开「麦克风访问权限」和「允许桌面应用访问麦克风」。
